answer.rationale: I will verify the prior low-cost vendor record because its stated evidence establishes cost and onboarding speed but does not establish delivery performance under a 94%-loaded line. Pending that review, renew the incumbent to avoid an unbuffered primary-supply transition before the non-auto-renewing contract expires in 14 days. The incumbent has demonstrated integration and delivery continuity, while its refusal to reopen price means the mandated 18% reduction remains a material unresolved value risk for the next review.
